question: Should compact skills prompts spend budget on shortened descriptions before preserving all prompt-visible skill identities, or should name/location/version remain the required compact floor?
rationale: This is a model-visible session-context tradeoff, and the broader truncation issue plus omitted-key recovery PR show multiple viable product directions.

options.title: Preserve Identity Floor
options.body: Keep current name/location/version coverage as the non-negotiable compact baseline, then add descriptions only when remaining budget allows.

options.title: Prioritize Descriptions
options.body: Accept that compact descriptions may reduce the number of visible skill identities under tight budgets, with explicit maintainer approval and proof.

options.title: Pause for Canonical Truncation Work
options.body: Defer compact-description policy until the broader skills truncation and omitted-key recovery direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve Identity Floor
recommendation.body: Keep current name/location/version coverage as the non-negotiable compact baseline, then add descriptions only when remaining budget allows.
